THREE_KINGDOMS-INIT_RELIC_ONE.title: Three Kingdoms - Core Relic
THREE_KINGDOMS-INIT_RELIC_ONE.descriptio: At the end of each turn, you may hold at most [blue]{HandLimit:diff()}[/blue] cards in your hand; discard the excess. You no longer discard your hand at the end of each turn. On the first turn you draw 1 extra card; on every later turn you draw 3 fewer cards. When you are about to take damage, play a Dodge from your hand. Your Block no longer expires automatically. (Core relic - do not remove.)
THREE_KINGDOMS-INIT_RELIC_ONE.flavor: The core relic of the Three Kingdoms ruleset
